title: David’s Service and Saul’s Spear
reflectionText: David serves wisely while Saul watches him with anger and fear. The people’s love, the thrown spear, and the unfulfilled marriage offer stand beside one another. What do you notice about David’s continued service as Saul’s words and actions toward him grow increasingly hostile?
